title: Branding
description: Local branding descriptor for the login UI. Carries the layout preset, asset URLs, the LiquidJS template (by file reference or inline), and the appearance settings - theme sides, typography and shape. `zitadel apply` publishes this as an immutable branding revision; flow responses resolve the latest revision per project. Every field is optional and an omitted key uses Zitadel's maintained default. This schema describes the local configuration shape only.

$schema.description: Editor affordance: path or URL of this meta-schema so editors validate and autocomplete the file (scaffolded branding files point at `.zitadel/meta/branding.json`). Ignored by the platform.

layout.description: Degrade preset (`centered` or `split`) the bundled default template branches on, not the complete design catalog. All named designs (`centered`, `split`, `split-right`, `hero`, `minimal`) ship as templates and map onto one of these two values; switch designs with the `branding eject --design <name>` command instead of editing this field. Custom templates may ignore it; the preset is also used when a template fails component-side validation.

liquid_template_file.description: Path to the LiquidJS template file, relative to this descriptor. The CLI inlines the file content into `liquid_template` when publishing, and writes server state back to the file. Mutually exclusive with `liquid_template`.

liquid_template.description: Inline LiquidJS template string. Prefer `liquid_template_file` — a real `.liquid` file edits far better than a JSON-escaped string. Mutually exclusive with `liquid_template_file`.

logo_url.description: Logo URL (https required; canonical loopback http is allowed for local development and renders only on loopback pages).

hero_url.description: Hero/background image URL (https required; canonical loopback http is allowed for local development and renders only on loopback pages), used by split designs.

theme.description: Which theme sides this project publishes, and which of them may run. Publishing one side makes it the only legal resolved theme.

mode.description: Which published side may run. `auto` follows the operating system.

light.description: The side used on a light surface.

dark.description: The side used on a dark surface.

typography.description: The typeface the login surface renders in. One face does both body and headings. Naming a family does not load it - `font_url` is the stylesheet that provides the face, which is why the two live together.

font_family.description: CSS font stack applied to body and heading text. Include a generic family. Comma-separated family names, each an identifier (Inter, ui-sans-serif) or a quoted name ("APK Futural").

font_url.description: Stylesheet that loads `typography.font_family` (https required; no loopback carve-out). Stored, but not injected into an embedding application's document — an embedded widget relies on the embedding page having loaded the face. Rejected without `font_family`.

scale.description: Multiplier on the base text sizes, 1 when omitted.

shape.description: Corner rounding, spacing, and the logo's size relative to its cap. Shared across theme sides.

radius.description: Corner rounding for the card, inputs, buttons and alerts. Either a preset name — `none` (0), `sm` (4), `md` (8), `lg` (12), `full` (pill) — or an integer number of pixels. One value scales the whole corner ramp in proportion.

logo_scale.description: Multiplier on the logo's maximum height, 1 when omitted. The image keeps its intrinsic aspect ratio inside that cap, so no width, height or ratio is stored.

brandingThemeSide.description: One complete theme side. Light and dark are independent surfaces - neither inherits from the other, and a side that is absent is never used, whatever mode or the operating system asks for.

logo_url.description: The mark for this surface (https required; canonical loopback http is allowed for local development). A logo is never recoloured, so each side carries its own ink file.

palette.description: Semantic colours for this theme side. A key omitted here uses the maintained default for this side, never the other side's value. Every value is a brandingColor.

primary.description: Brand colour. Also the source the focus rings are derived from.

on_primary.description: Text and icons drawn on top of `primary`.

muted.description: Neutral fills — secondary button, accents, muted panels.

text.description: Body text, and the foreground of every neutral surface.

link.description: Link colour. Defaults to the surrounding text colour.

success.description: Valid fields, success alerts and pills.

warning.description: Warning surfaces. Persisted; no atom stylesheet consumes it yet.

error.description: Invalid fields, error alerts and pills.

brandingColor.description: A colour on a theme side: hex (#4F46E5), a CSS colour name, or a colour function - rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), hsla(), hwb(), lab(), lch(), oklab(), oklch(), color() or color-mix(). url() and var() are rejected: the value is written into a stylesheet, so only forms that resolve to a colour are stored. The pattern pins the shape, so a value cannot leave its declaration whatever it spells; which names CSS knows is the browser's business, and an unrecognised one paints nothing.
